description: PR-194's root causes, one fault each, all under the single PR-194 ledger obligation (owner decision 2026-11-12: not split). Fault IDs in intersection-backfill.json are ledger records, so that catalogue holds one of them as PR-194; this supplementary catalogue declares its ledger defect and holds all six. CI replays every intersection-backfill*.json together (tools/mutate.py --catalogue tools/mutation/intersection-backfill*.json).
